title: Read the Ripples
text: Read the Ripples Abbreviation: RTR Prerequisites: 50th Circle, Seer's Sense, and a quest Signature: Yes Spell Slots: 2 Mana Type: Lunar Magic Spell Type: ritual / utility Difficulty: advanced Prep (min/max): 300 / 800 Skill Range (min/max): 250 / 1000 Valid Spell Target: Self Duration (min/max): 2 minutes / 10 minutes Justice: no Corruption: no Description: Read the Ripples is a lunar ritual built on a pattern unlike any other known to modern Moon Mages. Regardless of the oddity of its origins, the ritual has been proven to be safe, yet finicky. Those practiced with the ritual claim that it opens one's mind to the whims of Fate. Effect: Add prophetic insight, bypass astrological observation timers, and bypass telescope checks for selected random constellations. Example Messaging: On cast:You gaze towards the heavens seeking their silent guidance.The mental strain of this pattern is considerably eased by your ritual focus.Your prophetic connection blooms a thousand-fold as your ritual concludes. You are alone. An infinitesimal speck in space and time adrift in an infinite sea of possibility. The course of your life, past, present and future, dictated by ceaseless currents beyond any mortal control. But infinitesimal is not insignificant and control is not understanding. These are indisputable facts etched into the essence of every prophet. Random constellation selection: As your consciousness drifts amongst the currents of Fate you find yourself drawn towards the planet Ismenia. Observing the selected constellation: You scan the skies for a few moments. While invisible to the naked eye, your prophetic senses have little trouble resolving the planet Ismenia. The planet Ismenia is unobscured by clouds. Ismenia shines a bright, cheery yellow, almost seeming to smile as it beams its warm but distant light from above. The insight gained from your prior observations floats gently through your subconsciousness. You intuitively draw the relevant details to the forefront of your mind, using them to nurture your current efforts. You learned something useful from your observation. Effect ending: As your ritual ebbs away you find yourself returned to a world of immutable facts. Things that are, are, and things that are not, are not. This is indisputable and you are left with a lingering dissatisfaction for you are still alone, infinitesimal. Cooldown ending: The world dulls almost imperceptibly as the last remnants of the Read the Ripples ritual fade from your mind's eye Devices/Tattoos: No devices or tattoos documented. The spell selects random targets in the sky for you to OBSERVE. After you observe the object, the spell will select a new target on the next pulse for you to observe. This repeats until the ritual ends. For each object the spell selects, the timer for observing celestial objects is not enforced (It is enforced for other observations). Observing the constellations that the spell indicates reinforces each successive observation, adding an additional amount of prophetic insight. This includes the potential of adding it to a pool that the object may not otherwise fill on its own.

title: Offhand Weapon skill
text: To use the offhand skill, the word LEFT must immediately follow whichever attack verb is being used, as in SLICE LEFT. It is fully compatible with AMBUSH, so AMBUSH SLICE LEFT will function. Offhand attacks are a two skill contest, using 70% of your Offhand skill and 30% of the appropriate weapon skill. Likewise, the experience gained from attacking this way is also distributed 70/30. However, the hybrid amount of skill used to attack will never exceed the user's normal weapon skill. While skill with the weapon can partially compensate for lack of offhand skill, expertise with offhand does nothing if you lack the skill with the weapon. Barbarians, if meeting the restrictions, can use Whirlwind to attack with both their primary and offhand weapons. Thieves can Backstab offhand, if holding a suitable weapon in the offhand. The user's skillset placement determines the heaviest weapon they can use offhand. Primary Weapon: Heavy or lighter. Secondary Weapons: Medium or lighter. Tertiary Weapons: Light only. Two-handed weapons cannot be used in the offhand. It is not currently possible to parry with a weapon held in the offhand, although neither holding nor using a weapon in the offhand will prevent arm-worn shield use. Various GMs have indicated plans to allow for "Offhand Parry."

title: Small Edged skill
text: basic pattern of being either geared toward slicing or thrusting. While lacking the power of heavy and twohanded edged weapons, they trade only a minor amount of weight and balance to far outpace light edged weapons in terms of damage. While most of the weapons are swords of one sort or another, there are a few hand axes. These weapons are intended as an alternative with lower balance and higher strength suitability, but are generally lackluster. Barbarians can WHIRLWIND with any pole or melee weapon. This will attack all targets within range of their chosen weapon (melee or pole), including hidden targets. Hidden targets will be pulled from hiding if hit by whirlwind. WHIRL can also be used on one's self or another to free the target from webbing. Requirements: 350 in the weapon skill and 32 agility. Barbarians and Paladins can parry ranged weapons inside the range of the weapon they are holding. With a light edged or medium edged weapon, a Thief may make a backstab attack, which is a special sort of ambush that deals increased damage. Light edged weapons tend to be more accurate, but less damaging. Thieves are also capable of using ambush slash using a light edged weapon, a crippling attack that targets an opponents legs. The default pattern for a Moonblade is medium edged, and Moon Mages have a few abilities that will not work on some of the other patterns. Thieves, Clerics, Rangers, Bards and Warrior Mages can wield medium edged and medium blunt weapons in their offhand, thanks to being weapon secondary. As the only weapon prime guild, Barbarians also have access to this ability, and can wield even larger weapons offhand. All guilds can wield a light edged weapon in their offhand. a ivory-hilted jambiya (Great LE slicer) a finely balanced tago (Decent, easily available LE jabber) Click here to search for related posts.

title: Experience command
heading_path: Special Uses > EXP BONUS > Usage and Syntax
text: EXP BONUS: tells you the status of these skillsets, ie. how much experience remains in each. Your Armor pool could fill one empty skill to 10 ranks. Your Weapon pool could fill one empty skill to 24 ranks. Your Magic pool could fill 7 empty skills to 200 ranks and one empty skill to 69 ranks. Your Survival pool could fill one empty skill to 145 ranks. This pool is currently turned off. Your Lore pool could fill 10 empty skills to 200 ranks and one empty skill to 188 ranks. EXP BONUS TOGGLE <skillset>: is used to turn each skillset pool on or off as you desire. When toggled off, no experience will be drained from that pool. This allows you to target which skills you want the bonus experience to end up in. >exp bonus toggle magic You will no longer drain additional experience from your Magic bonus pool. >exp bonus toggle magic You will now drain additional experience from your Magic bonus pool. For additional information, please see Magic 3.0 EXP SWITCH is a temporary command which is used to manage the grandfathered levels of the four new Magic skills which were introduced with DR 3.0, Utility skill, Warding skill, Augmentation skill, and Debilitation skill. This allows a player to choose for him- or herself the relative level of expertise in each of these new skills, by swapping the experience between them.

title: Fire of Ushnish
text: Fire of Ushnish Abbreviation: FOU Prerequisites: Circle 40, a quest, and Fists of Faenella or Horn of the Unicorn Signature: Yes Spell Slots: 2 Mana Type: Holy Magic Spell Type: battle / targeted, pulse damage, area of effect Difficulty: advanced Prep (min/max): 30 / 100 Skill Range (min/max): 250 / 1000 Valid Spell Target: Area Duration (min/max): Instant Justice: illegal Corruption: none Description: An infernal cataclysm spun into magic, this spell wrings the fires of the World Dragon from its very throat! From the bowels of Elanthia's core, Ushnish's ire will spew forth -- but it will be up to your skill to converge its flows upon enemies. Beware, for calling out His name in invocation is seldom without peril. Effect: Fire damage, Electrical damage, AoE with a second, half-power attack. Example Messaging: You strike your heel against the ground. Fiery white magma bubbles up from the dirt underfoot! A grass eel's ethereal shield crackles with energy! The stream of liquid white fire washes over a grass eel's slender body, badly charring it. The grass eel is dealt a vicious stun! A goblin shaman's ethereal shield crackles with energy! Blackened embers and flakes of ash swirl away from a goblin shaman's abdomen as it is incinerated by the white lava, leaving behind naught but a smoking ruin. A goblin shaman sinks to the ground in a rustle of cloth and covers its face with the hood of its cloak. Slowly the movements of the cloaked creature stop. A glowing stick shatters into a million glittering splinters. The shimmering ethereal shield fades from around a goblin shaman. Blackened embers and flakes of ash swirl away from a grass eel's slender body as it is incinerated by the white lava, leaving behind naught but a smoking ruin. A grass eel shudders, then goes limp. Roundtime: 2 sec. Boiling tongues of magma race wrathfully in another path. A grass eel's ethereal shield crackles with energy! Blackened embers and flakes of ash swirl away from a grass eel's slender body as it is incinerated by the white lava, leaving behind naught but a smoking ruin. A grass eel thrashes about wildly for a few seconds, then lies still. The shimmering ethereal shield fades from around a grass eel. The trickles of white magma cool, forming ashy cinders which quickly disperse. Devices/Tattoos: No devices or tattoos documented. See TARGET for targeting options. If successful, may pull (Melee, Pole?) targets from hiding, even if it deals no damage.

title: Warn command
text: Suitable for roleplayed conflicts where it is to the players' advantage to have consent on record. title: Awaken (spell)
text: Awaken (spell) Abbreviation: AWAKEN Prerequisites: Mental Focus Signature: No Spell Slots: 2 Mana Type: Life Magic Spell Type: battle / utility Difficulty: intermediate Prep (min/max): 15 / 100 Skill Range (min/max): 80 / 800 Valid Spell Target: Self, PC Duration (min/max): 2 minutes / 10 minutes Justice: no Corruption: no Description: This spell will attempt to awaken any living thing which is unconscious, and may also free the mind from other stuporous confines. A self-cast Awaken spell pattern will settle over the Empath quiescently, rousing to activity when his mental equilibrium is disrupted. Effect: -stuns/unconsciousness Example Messaging: You gesture. The vivacious energies of your spell focalize around your head. As the pattern reaches deeply beyond your conscious mind, you are pervaded by a feeling of sobered vigilance. Devices/Tattoos: No devices or tattoos documented. Duration is only when self cast. The spell cannot be pre-cast on others. There is a myth that the spell Awaken helps to save patients who are "in shock and dying." This was confirmed false by GM Naohhi in a forum post on 1/11/2015[1]. While I sometimes enjoy reading the stupid that sprouts up.. Awaken Attempts to cure the states known as Unconscious and Stunned. Does nothing to the state known as Dying state that may also be referred to as Pre Death Shock, not to be confused with Empathic Shock. Using Awaken on someone in the dying state is as useless as offering lavender to Meraud. Meaning, you can do it, but those of us that know better are just laughing at you while you make yourself look silly. When asked whether Awaken ever had any effect on the dying state, GM Naohhi responded: there was never a bug that did anything like that. Awaken has not changed since it was released. I looked at the code before I posted. Click here to search for related posts.

title: Sovereign Destiny
text: Sovereign Destiny Abbreviation: SOD Prerequisites: Sever Thread or Tangled Fate Signature: Yes Spell Slots: 2 Mana Type: Lunar Magic Spell Type: battle / debilitation Difficulty: intermediate Prep (min/max): 5 / 33 Skill Range (min/max): 80 / 800 Valid Spell Target: PC, Creature Duration (min/max): Instant Justice: illegal, social corruption Corruption: teleologic corruption Description: The Elemental infusion of the Pattern of Prophecy, Sovereign Destiny is an ambitious spell which seeks to free the subject's shadow from the Plane of Probability, liberating them from the forces of destiny. While the sorcery is imperfect, as the shadow will eventually reform, the implication of even this mild success is greatly encouraging to the devoted teleologic sorcerer. The practical implication of the spell is usually limited to a mild sense of disorientation that fades as the shadow gradually reforms. However, the sudden withdrawal from the Plane of Probability is oft devastating to those gifted with foresight. Effect: -Discipline (stat), -Intelligence (stat), -Wisdom (stat), removes predictions, blocks access to Plane of Probability Example Messaging: You gesture at a wild boar. Color seeps from the world, leaving the area cloaked in monotone shadow except for a vivid purple glow that lingers around a wild boar as you attempt to free it. Your sorcery shreds the web of fate that surrounds a wild boar, freeing it of its destiny. <Mage> gestures at you. Color seeps from the world, leaving the area cloaked in monotone shadow except for a vivid purple glow that lingers around you. An appalling tearing sensation passes reality as <mage>'s sorcery attacks the web of fate around you, wresting away your probabilistic shadow and leaving you terrifyingly free. The threads of prophecy gripping you groan inaudibly as they are forcibly unravel from about you. The world rapidly resaturates with color. Roundtime: 2 sec. Contest Type: spirit / willpower Devices/Tattoos: Rectangular vellum shaded a vivid purple Has some devastating side effects, mostly to Moon Mages. Firstly it will end all active predictions, or spells that require the Plane of Probability to work (specifically: enlightened geometry or teleological sorcery spells, plus Seer's Sense). Secondly it will block the casting of these spells as well as any prediction attempts for the duration. Trying to predict while under the effects: You reach towards the Plane of Probability, but find... nothing. While you are currently free of destiny, it too is free of you. Click here to search for related posts.

title: Syamelyo Kuniyo
text: Syamelyo Kuniyo Abbreviation: SK Prerequisites: Circle 70 and Skein of Shadows or Oath of the Firstborn Signature: No Spell Slots: 3 Mana Type: Life Magic Spell Type: battle / augmentation Difficulty: advanced Prep (min/max): 30 / 100 Skill Range (min/max): 250 / 1000 Valid Spell Target: Self Duration (min/max): 2 minutes / 10 minutes Justice: no Corruption: no Description: The cycle of life is sacred to Kuniyo in a way Rangers can best resonate with. With every whistling arrow and with every hunt, we pay homage to the forest god. An archer with the power of Syamelyo Kuniyo will be able to line up that perfect first shot much more swiftly and strike with the cold fury of nature. This is a battle spell, intended to be prepared quickly and cast on a single target while in battle. It can be cast without a target. Effect: Makes the first aim on every enemy faster, converts that shot's damage type to purely cold, additional damage boost. Example Messaging: cast:The left side of the world becomes hazed in gauzy green shadows briefly, and you find yourself drifting to the verge of reveries paradisiac and exhilarating. drop:Your green-shadowed reveries grow distant. You turn to face a mutant togball. In one frozen moment, your thoughts shift to a dreamlike tableau: a dugong and a sea otter foraging together in shallow waters off the shores of a pristine tree-covered island. You deftly draw your battle longbow's string and begin to aim at a mutant togball. Devices/Tattoos: No devices or tattoos documented. Guild Leader Paglar in Boar Clan teaches this spell. Affects both arrows when paired with dual loading. There is a five minute cooldown before it can be used against the same target. The cooldown will reset when a player target leaves the room before the Ranger does. There is now messaging when a target-specific cooldown expires. SK's elemental damage will not apply if the arrow already has elemental damage of any kind, or if the target creature is immune to the elemental damage type SK is trying to apply. (If the target is immune to cold damage, it will not change to cold.) Damage type can be modified by the metaspell Electrogenesis, converting it from cold to electric. title: Aspects of the All-God
text: Aspects of the All-God Abbreviation: ALL Prerequisites: 20th circle Signature: Yes Spell Slots: 2 Mana Type: Holy Magic Spell Type: ritual / augmentation, utility Difficulty: basic Prep (min/max): 50 / 600 Skill Range (min/max): 10 / 600 Valid Spell Target: Special Duration (min/max): Instant minutes Justice: illegal, social corruption Corruption: antinomic corruption Description: Monotheism is a rare thing in Elanthia, and yet every yokel hears of the All-God early in life. Our guildsmen are taught to extol the disparate virtues of the Thirteen, but at the same time, how could one abjure what is essentially the sum of their beliefs? And so the All-God ever exists in the margins of other religions -- the god of gods who are mere facets of creation. Harnessing such a deep-rooted mythos comes easy to an antinomic godling. Coaxed by the right Elemental blend, it might assume any facet that is convenient for its sorcerer, or all of them, albeit in ways poorly understood. Effect: +Augmentation skill, +Debilitation skill, +Sorcery skill, +Targeted Magic skill, +Utility skill, +Warding skill, -Primary Magic skill, -Augmentation skill, -Debilitation skill, -Targeted Magic skill, -Utility skill, -Warding skill, Rapid alignment change. Nonstandard alignments. Example Messaging: Skuyaseor's metamorphosis manifests as a heavenly, mouthwatering scent of grapefruits and quinces. Your deep-seated harmony with Drogor is unwoven by dint of sorcerous realignment, setting off a maelstrom of spiritual distortion in the vicinity until it comes to fruition. You open up your soul to the influence of the All-God. Consciousness flees as your spiritual essence is subtly spun into a deific design. Soon, a new outlook on the world takes root, even though something is not quite right... You are now an element of the divine meaning with which the All-God suffuses this plane of being. Devices/Tattoos: Illuminated scroll of pure white vellum New alignment options. Ritual spells require the use of a ritual focus. The magical feat Improvised Rituals is required for use of universal ritual foci such as the slender alabaster staff with a silver cobra coiled along it. Limited use foci attuned to the Antinomic Sorcery Spellbook such as the Jade apple can be used to cast Aspects of the All-God without knowledge of the Improvised Rituals magical feat. Will cause Antinomic Corruption (POTENTIAL SPOILERS) Casting this spell (or having it visible) inside a standard justice zone generates Social Outrage. Using this spell to align with a non-standard god does not require being on consecrated ground or using a lit altar candle. To align with a non-standard god, prep the spell at maximum mana (cambrinth and universal ritual foci will work), and CAST <god>. This doesn't require that your antinomic godling be at any specific power level. Using SPELL STANCE POTENCY for maximum oomph is recommended. Click here to search for related posts.

title: Failure of the Forge
text: Failure of the Forge Abbreviation: FOTF Prerequisites: Demrris' Resolve Signature: No Spell Slots: 2 Ward Slots: This spell uses 1 ward slot when cast by Bards, 2 ward slots for everyone else. Mana Type: Elemental Magic Spell Type: standard / warding Difficulty: basic Prep (min/max): 5 / 100 Skill Range (min/max): 10 / 600 Valid Spell Target: Self, PC Duration (min/max): 10 minutes / 40 minutes Justice: no Corruption: no Description: Failure of the Forge is an unusual warding pattern which allows the magician to cloak themself in an aura of aural dissonance. If an attack lands against the spellcaster, the dissonance lashes out, imbuing any weapon in the attacker's hands with distracting harmonics. In effect, this makes the weapons temporarily less suited for combat, though the discerning magician should beware that this magical counter-attack does nothing to cushion them against the initial blow. Effect: Token amount of damage reduction. Debuffs weapons held by aggressors. Example Messaging: Cast:A dissonant chord echoes through the area as a distorted shimmer briefly flows around you. Debuff application: 3rd person: A Dragon Priest zealot's lata'oloh is caught by your aural assault, imbuing it with imbalancing harmonics. 1st person: Your lance is caught by a sweeping arc of sound, causing it to vibrate uncomfortably in your hand. Damage reduction: With a vengeful crescendo, sonic forces lash out in defense! Spell ending: You hear, more than feel, the Failure of the Forge pattern wind down and lose cohesion. Devices/Tattoos: No devices or tattoos documented. Any weapon held by the aggressor (whether or not it was actually used in the assault) will be debuffed for a short time, similar in concept to the Cleric spell Curse of Zachriedek. The debuff will trigger on any strike that is at least glancing. Debuffs all 3 physical damage types of a weapon. The debuff does not work on natural attacks from critters or brawling attacks from players and the weapon attack that triggers the debuff effect does not receive any benefit from the debuff. The effect cannot be triggered again on the same target until it has worn off completely from that target. There is no messaging to indicate when the debuff has worn off. Provides a very small amount of always on damage reduction to the caster independent of the debuff effect. Click here to search for related posts.

title: Yelp command
text: Yelp A roleplaying action for making a yelping sound. YELP You see: You let out a high-pitched yelp! Others see: <Person> lets out a high-pitched yelp! This verb cannot be directed at a particular person.

title: Fortress of Ice
text: Fortress of Ice Abbreviation: FOI Prerequisites: 30th Circle, Frostbite or Ice Patch Signature: Yes Spell Slots: 3 Mana Type: Elemental Magic Spell Type: standard / utility Difficulty: advanced Prep (min/max): 30 / 100 Skill Range (min/max): 250 / 1000 Valid Spell Target: PC, Group, Area Duration (min/max): <30"" can not be assigned to a declared number type with value 30. minutes / <60"" can not be assigned to a declared number type with value 60. minutes Justice: no Corruption: no Description: The Fortress of Ice spell creates a tall ring of impenetrable ice walls which isolate the caster and those closest to him. Though the walls cannot be scaled from outside, footholds on the inside allow escape. Effect: Creates a private room. Example Messaging: You gesture. Four pillars of silvery-blue light form at the cardinal points around you, filling the air with the lethal cold of deep winter. They begin spinning, casting off a glowing blue mist that quickly forms into solid walls. You quickly realize that you are enclosed within the walls, separated from the rest of the area. You are now within the Fortress! CAST ROOF: You gesture. The top edges of the icy walls glow with a soft blue light as jagged shards of ice project outward toward the center of the opening. The spikes cross each other violently and build on one another until the entire opening is obscured. FOCUS: You focus your magical senses on an Ice Fortress. The Ice Fortress has a definite magical pattern, which apparently holds the magically enhanced ice into its shape. You recognize the pattern as a manifestation of Elemental magic. It seems to involve Water Manipulation. The pattern appears to be the result of the Fortress of Ice spell. The Ice Fortress seems unoccupied. or You sense of the presence of <person> Roundtime: 25 sec. Devices/Tattoos: No devices or tattoos documented. Once inside a fortress it is possible to bring people from the outside into the fortress with you. To do this you must first WATCH WALL to see the outside of the fortress. Then prep FOI and cast on the person you wish to bring inside. Group members are automatically entered into the fortress when cast. All enemies at pole or melee range with the caster are brought into the fortress. Regardless of where the spell is cast, the area inside the fortress is a justice-free zone. LOOK WALL will show the outside of the fortress once. WATCH WALL will continue to watch the room outside the fortress for a couple of minutes, and output to the Familiar window if available. The duration can be replaced by casting the spell again inside of the fortress. Primary magic skill seems to determine efficiency and messaging: fumbling slightly, with moderate skill, etc. Additional casts will destabalize the spell pattern, to the point where it's impossible to add more power.
